description:
Jilin Wangou Afforestation Project is located in Fusong County, Jingyu County and Jiangyuan District, Baishan City, Jilin Province, China. The project’s aim is to increase carbon sequestration and contribute to local sustainable development by planting trees on the barren lands. 

Prior to the project activity, according to the baseline survey, the project area has been barren since 1989, causing substantial soil and water erosion, biodiversity loss, contributed to climate change, and perpetuated low income and living condition in local communities. There are mainly scatter shrub and grass land in the project area prior to the project activity.

An area which belongs to Wangou Forestry Bureau of Jilin Province, have been planted, on more than 1,000 parcels of lands. All the trees are native species, including Manchurian Ash, Phellodendron amurense Rupr, Juglans mandshurica and Korean pine. No invasive alien species or genetically modified organisms are involved.

The project would generate GHG emission removals and improve local environment by planting trees, enhance biodiversity conservation and climate change adaptation, improve soil and water conservation in project zone, strengthening the live skills of local communities and residents by providing their relevant technical skills and training and create more permanent job opportunities for local women and increase income for local communities.

In addition, this project is expected to provide more than 5,690 full-time jobs. To contribute to the local sustainable development, the proposed project activity, the proposed forestation activity, the proposed forestation activity aims to:
- Sequester carbon dioxide and mitigating climate change
- Enhance biodiversity conservation by increasing the connectivity of forests which is critical for wildlife
- Improve the quality and quantity of the vegetation
- Improve soil and water conservation in project areas
- Generate income and job opportunities for local communities
